entries.english:
On 7 May 1379 in Prague, Cardinal-Priest Pileus grants an indulgence to Hohenfurt Abbey at the request of the brothers Peter and Johann von Rosenberg.

Pileus, by divine mercy Cardinal-Priest of the title of St Praxedis, endowed with the apostolic authority set out below, to all the faithful in Christ who see this letter, greetings in the Lord. The splendor of the Father’s glory, which illuminates the world with ineffable brightness, graciously supports the pious wishes of the faithful who trust in his most merciful majesty, especially when their devout humility is aided by the prayers and merits of the saints; and Christ’s faithful more readily come together in devotion when they see themselves more abundantly refreshed there by the gift of heavenly grace. Since our beloved in Christ Peter, provost of the chapel of All Saints in Prague Castle, and Johann, his full brother, barons of the Kingdom of Bohemia, have special affection and devotion toward the monastery at Hohenfurt of the Order of St Bernard in the Diocese of Prague, founded by their grandfather Henry of blessed memory, and have humbly petitioned us to grant spiritual gifts to increase devotion to it, we, favorably granting these petitions, relying on the mercy of Almighty God, the merits of his blessed apostles Peter and Paul, and the aforesaid authority, mercifully remit forty days of the penances imposed on them to all truly penitent and confessed persons who devoutly pray once each week for the soul of the aforesaid Henry, the pious founder of the monastery, and for their other predecessors. Given at Prague on the Nones of May, in the second year of the pontificate of our most holy father in Christ and lord, Lord Urban, by divine providence Pope VI. Jo. Bouenhert (?).

On the document’s fold: ‘vni. R. S.’, with ‘pj=’ below it. A very fine, large seal hangs from a green silk cord in red wax. It shows five chapels, in the lowest of which is a praying bishop, with coats of arms on either side bearing a horizontal bar above five fleurs-de-lis (?). Inscription: ‘S. Pilei Tt. See. Praxedis Presbri. Cardinalis.’
